title: History and Evolution of Kotlin knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “History and Evolution of Kotlin”?
options: It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
Language versions, compiler versions, plugins, and library versions evolve independently enough that release notes and compatibility tables must be checked.
It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.
questions.answer_key: Language versions, compiler versions, plugins, and library versions evolve independently enough that release notes and compatibility tables must be checked.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Language versions, compiler versions, plugins, and library versions evolve independently enough that release notes and compatibility tables must be checked. Ignore warnings and suppress failures before identifying the cause.

questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
